clues.it: Nino era nella 2ª colonna e nella stessa stanza di Dario.
clues.en: Nino was in the 2nd column and in the same room as Dario.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 3ª colonna, in una stanza diversa da Paolo e nella Cripta.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 3rd column, in a different room from Paolo and in the Crypt.

clues.it: Dario era accanto a una statua di Anubi, ma non era accanto a un seggio di pietra.
clues.en: Dario was beside a statue of Anubis, but was not beside a stone seat.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Olga era l'unica persona su un cumulo di sabbia e accanto a un cumulo di sabbia, ma non era accanto a un braciere.
clues.en: Olga was the only person on a sand drift and beside a sand drift, but was not beside a brazier.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 6ª riga e nel Corridoio dei Geroglifici, ma non era accanto a una statua di Anubi.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 6th row and in the Hall of Hieroglyphs, but was not beside a statue of Anubis.

clues.it: Rosa era accanto a dei geroglifici, a un obelisco e in una stanza diversa da Olga.
clues.en: Rosa was beside hieroglyphs, an obelisk and in a different room from Olga.

clues.it: Marta era in una stanza diversa da Ugo e nella Camera del Tesoro.
clues.en: Marta was in a different room from Ugo and in the Treasury.

clues.it: Irene era accanto a un'urna canopa, ma non era accanto a una colonna.
clues.en: Irene was beside a canopic jar, but was not beside a column.

clues.it: Ugo era nella 5ª colonna, ma non era accanto a un cumulo di sabbia.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 5th column, but was not beside a sand drift.

general_clues.en: 2 people in the Hall of Hieroglyphs.
5 in the west half of the grid.
5 in the north half of the grid.
